title: API & Basic Functionality Tests
summary: This module contains integration tests that validate the core API endpoints and fundamental functionalities of the Ollama server, including chat, generation, model listing, and basic model interactions. It ensures the server behaves as expected under various conditions and with different model types.

nodes.label: Test Chat API
nodes.title: Test Chat API Endpoint
nodes.description: Verifies the `/api/chat` endpoint's functionality for both streaming and non-streaming responses, checking response structure, metrics, and content.

nodes.label: Test Chat Logprobs
nodes.title: Test Chat API Logprobs
nodes.description: Validates the `/api/chat` endpoint's logprobs feature, ensuring correct structure, values, and token-to-byte matching.

nodes.label: Test Generate API
nodes.title: Test Generate API Endpoint
nodes.description: Checks the `/api/generate` endpoint for streaming and non-streaming responses, including response structure, metrics, content, and running model details.

nodes.label: Test List Models API
nodes.title: Test List Models API Endpoint
nodes.description: Confirms the `/api/tags` endpoint returns a non-empty list of models with essential details like name, size, and digest.

nodes.label: Test Generate Logprobs
nodes.title: Test Generate API Logprobs
nodes.description: Evaluates the `/api/generate` endpoint's logprobs feature, covering cases with and without `top_logprobs`, and verifying structure and sorting.

nodes.label: Test Show Model API
nodes.title: Test Show Model API Endpoint
nodes.description: Verifies the `/api/show` endpoint retrieves comprehensive model details, including license, modelfile, parameters, and modified date.

nodes.label: Test Unicode Chat
nodes.title: Test Unicode Character Handling in Chat
nodes.description: Ensures the chat functionality correctly processes and generates Unicode characters in prompts and responses, using a specific model.

nodes.label: Test Basic Chat
nodes.title: Test Basic Chat Functionality
nodes.description: A fundamental test of the chat API with a standard prompt, verifying expected responses.

nodes.label: Test Unicode Model Directory
nodes.title: Test Unicode Paths for Models (Windows)
nodes.description: A Windows-specific test to confirm that the system handles model directories with Unicode characters correctly.

nodes.label: Test Extended Unicode Output
nodes.title: Test Emoji and Extended Unicode Output
nodes.description: Validates that the chat API can generate and handle extended Unicode characters, such as emojis, in its output.

nodes.label: Test Num Predict Option
nodes.title: Test num_predict Option in Generate API
nodes.description: Verifies that the `num_predict` option in the generate API accurately limits the number of tokens generated.

nodes.label: Test Library Models Chat
nodes.title: Test Chat Across Library Models
nodes.description: Tests chat functionality against a diverse set of models from the library, including special handling for specific model types.

nodes.label: Test Model Architectures Chat
nodes.title: Test Chat Across Model Architectures
nodes.description: Evaluates chat functionality across various model architectures, incorporating VRAM checks and GPU utilization monitoring.

nodes.label: Test Model Embeddings
nodes.title: Test Embedding Generation for Models
nodes.description: Validates the embedding generation capability for different models, comparing results with expected values using cosine similarity.

nodes.label: Test Model Performance
nodes.title: Test Performance of Various Models
nodes.description: Conducts performance benchmarks for a range of models to assess their efficiency and speed.

nodes.label: Test Library Models Performance
nodes.title: Test Performance of Library Models
nodes.description: Executes performance tests specifically for models available in the library.

nodes.label: Test Model Quantization
nodes.title: Test Model Quantization Process
nodes.description: Verifies the process of quantizing models, including creation, metadata validation, and basic chat functionality with the quantized output.

nodes.label: Test Thinking Enabled
nodes.title: Test 'Thinking' Feature When Enabled
nodes.description: Confirms the 'thinking' feature in chat requests works as expected, producing intermediate thought processes and preventing raw tag leakage.

nodes.label: Test Thinking Suppressed
nodes.title: Test 'Thinking' Feature When Suppressed
nodes.description: Ensures that when the 'thinking' feature is not requested, the main content is clean of internal tags, even if some models might still produce suppressed thinking output.

nodes.label: API Server
nodes.title: Ollama API Server
nodes.description: The core Ollama API server that handles requests for chat, generation, model management, and other functionalities.

nodes.label: Language Models
nodes.title: Various Language Models
nodes.description: Different language models (e.g., Llama, Gemma, DeepSeek) used by the Ollama server for text generation, chat, and embeddings.

groups.label: API Endpoint Tests
groups.title: API Endpoint Tests
groups.description: Tests verifying the functionality and response structures of various core API endpoints like chat, generate, list, and show.

groups.label: Basic Functionality Tests
groups.title: Basic Functionality Tests
groups.description: Tests covering fundamental operations such as basic chat, Unicode handling in prompts/outputs, and specific API options like `num_predict`.

groups.label: Model Compatibility Tests
groups.title: Model Compatibility Tests
groups.description: Tests evaluating the server's interaction with a variety of language models, including different architectures and embedding capabilities.

groups.label: Performance Tests
groups.title: Performance Tests
groups.description: Tests designed to measure and verify the performance characteristics of various models and the server.

groups.label: Model Management Tests
groups.title: Model Management Tests
groups.description: Tests focused on model lifecycle operations, such as the quantization process and verification of model metadata.

groups.label: Advanced Chat Features Tests
groups.title: Advanced Chat Features Tests
groups.description: Tests specifically for advanced chat features like the 'thinking' capability, ensuring correct behavior when enabled or suppressed.
